Tao: Quick sync  proposal: run a regional APAC micro-launch that ties localized prompt templates + staggered credit amounts + a short, live workshop timed for APAC evenings. Goal: improve signup->3 queries within 48h by ~12%.

Priya: Love it. Localization angle is smart. Which markets? JP, SG, AU?

Tao: Start with SG + AU, add JP if we can localize copy. Seed 400 signups total, split A/B. A gets 100 credits + localized templates + workshop invite; B gets 100 credits + templates only.

Marco: Suggest a small credit taper test: within A, subsplit 80 users get 200 credits to test sensitivity. Keep small to limit cost.

Leah: Routing: add utm=apac_influencer and signup metadata seed_region=apac. Seeded users should skip global tour and see localized templates modal with "Try sample" CTA. Enqueue 12h and 36h nudges timed to local evenings.

Priya: Prompt packs examples: "meet-notes-sg" (English + local phrasing) and "sales-short-au". I'll draft localized copy and banners.

Marco: Cost estimate: 400*100=40k credits; 200-credit subsplit adds 16k. Token cost still modest. I'll wire cohort dashboards for activation funnel and 7d retention.

Tao: Timeline: assets + localized landing by Mon EOD, routing live Tue 07:00 PT (aligned to APAC evening), influencer posts Tue local evening, workshop Wed 19:00 SGT.

Leah: Ops: require email verify before claim and add spam rollback (pause issuance + whitelist). Also log region flag for product experiments.

deploy-bot: Created calendar event "APAC micro-workshop: localized prompts" Wed 19:00 SGT  invites posted to #marketing.

Tao: Action items: Priya (localized assets), Marco (analytics + subsplit), Leah (routing + gating). Check-in Tue 9AM PT. :rocket:
